comment: Dr. Ooten was my professor for my FYS and she made the class very manageable. Papers were clear and spaced, journal prompts were short and direct, and lectures were directly connected to content being studied inside and outside of class. She's also genuinely caring, considerate, and excited to help students. I'd 100% recommend!
I love Dr. Ooten and have taken her multiple times. I will continue to go back to her in the future for advice!
Not much to say kind off a cut and dry professor. Didn't feel like I clicked with her but overall nice. Grading is kinda iffy and she changes her rubric like 6 times before the due date.

Not very clear on grading criteria. Not very flexible. Pretty decent lecturer. She seems nice enough but not sure if she really cares about her students. Would not recommend if you care about your gpa.

I had Dr. Ooten as my Endeavor/FYS professor. She is a very nice person and a great professor, although she does tend to assign more homework than the average FYS professor. She is also a tough grader when it comes to papers. However, she is always very clear in her expectations and is willing to meet with you outside of class to help.
